title: Octopus Violinist and Candle
description: A surreal painting depicts a purple octopus wearing a beret, playing a violin while floating amidst swirling green and black smoke-like tendrils with musical notes flowing from the instrument. Below, a tall purple candle with a bright green flame sits on a leafy base, casting a shadow.
prompt: Surreal fantasy artwork of a purple octopus wearing a dark beret, playing a violin with its tentacles, musical notes floating in the air. The creature is surrounded by flowing black and emerald green swirling smoke and vine patterns. In the foreground, a tall dripping purple candle with a glowing green flame and leafy base. Ethereal white background, high contrast, intricate linework, mystical atmosphere.
